title: Audit QQ16 child-error grid closure and certify sharp projected guards
body:
## Result and scope

PR3181 uses the dyadic denominators of ideal input columns to set scalar rounding error to zero while allowing approximate native children. A returned value on the working grid does not by itself make the next half-ADD exact. This package gives two adjacent, source-bound child/half-ADD countermodels and a corrected lattice criterion that includes independent child-error columns at every intermediate cut.

In the same scalar projection used by PR3181, a complete census of **7,004 child-error columns** gives sharp uniform guards:

| Program | Ideal input guard | Independent child-error guard |
|---|---:|---:|
| F0 | 4 | 4 |
| B1,2 | 17 | **18** |

Twelve B1,2 child sites need the eighteenth position. One unit defect after child 13489 on L344 has coefficient `-81921/262144` in L93 after scalar 26472. The odd numerator supplies an exact lower witness; the all-column replay supplies the upper bound in the stated projection.

The global census treats non-scalar operators as identities, explicitly records that scope, and covers F0/B1,2 only. The adjacent local witnesses retain the actual instructions with no intervening operation. These establish a missing receiver-side condition under an error-only child contract. They do not establish a full native rounding failure, disprove every possible `50+beta` accuracy implementation, or supply an admitted physical bit width. A defect lattice is also distinct from a returned-value lattice. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Verification

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/qq16-noise-lattice-audit
```

Expected: `PASS_QQ16_NOISE_LATTICE_AUDIT` with input guards `4,17` and child guards `4,18`; six independent witness checks; eleven passing tests; `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

The primary exact replay checks every input and child-error column at all 42,426 completed scalar cuts. A separate implementation uses dense single-channel forward propagation and reverse duals for the four sharp attainments and two adjacent examples. Negative controls cover altered witnesses, insufficient guards, source corruption, endpoint cancellation and later clearing. Registered Python 3.12.14 replay passes; a read-only, Git-free export of the committed nine package/input files passes on optimized Python 3.14.7 with unchanged bytes. The original PR3181 read-only verifier also passes with its repository-root variable redirected to the authenticated input checkout; its files were unchanged.

Fresh overlap covered 306 open PRs and 1,973 discussion records, with no matching child-error guard census identified. Earlier #2995/#3017/#3036 faults have different coverage.

Credit dcharb78 for PR3181's ideal-column/adjoint work, the retained QQ16 native-word authors, Nick Petalas / #2965, Arham Tahir / #2995/#3036, and Tekalign / #3017.
